description: This file defines the DisplayField class, an ORM entity representing display fields within the OrangeHRM system, with properties such as id and className, and a collection of related SelectedDisplayField instances.

classes.name: DisplayField
classes.description: An ORM entity representing a display field, with id and className properties, and relations to SelectedDisplayFields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the display field.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name associated with the display field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name associated with the display field.
